articles.summary: BrilliA Incorporated (NYSE American: BRIA) ("BrilliA" or the "Company") , a one-stop service and solution provider for ladies' intimate apparel brands worldwide, today announced that management will participate in the A.G.P. Virtual Consumer Showcase, on November 12, 2026. Kendrew Hartanto, CEO, will participate in a fireside chat at 9:45-10:15 AM ET. All existing and prospective shareholders are invited to join the webcast to learn more about the Company. DATE: November 12, 2026 TIME: 9:45-10:15 AM ET LINK: https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_Ynfr4Ge4Q26Um_dg8csS4w#/registration The live webcast will be available following registration using the dedicated link above and in the Events Presentations section of the BrilliA website at https://brilliaincorporated.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx .
